metadata.description: Falken's Lab extensions for agents built on agent-kit, and plugins for Claude Code: each one a Claude Code plugin as it is.

plugins.name: moodle-teacher
plugins.description: Work in your Moodle courses as their teacher, through moodle-mcp: building them, grading, following the class, checking and reusing courses, with how to do each well in Moodle.

plugins.name: moodle-student
plugins.description: Work in your Moodle courses as a student, through moodle-mcp: what you have left and when, assignments, quizzes, forums and the other activities, your grades and feedback, with how to do each well in Moodle.

plugins.name: moodle-ui-kit
plugins.description: A clean visual style for what your agent publishes in Moodle: assignment statements, code blocks, solutions, quiz questions and feedback, with inline styles that work on any Moodle site. Based on noeper's moodle-ui-kit.

plugins.name: weather
plugins.description: The weather in your city, for an agent that plans with you: today and the next days. Also agent-kit's example of an extension with its own MCP server.

plugins.name: docker-lab
plugins.description: Docker as a lab for your agent: it runs and tries software (tools, services, someone's code) in isolated containers without touching your computer, verifies that things work by running them, and manages your Docker, through docker-mcp, in the mode you choose (only read, only labs, or everything).
